_doc: OUR dependency list for the fidelity risk map. impact: 3 high, 2 med, 1 low (effect on the 4 gated metrics, fidelity-gate spec). confidence: 0..1, how sure we are that d2d matches game.exe 1.14d for the metrics, from evidence listed. d2d_files: upstream source files whose function refs are counted. exe_files: game.exe source-file labels from functions.tsv. addresses: key game.exe functions whose status is shown. gap_src: listed upstream gaps (suffix of the gap's source field) that touch the area. cost_h: agent-hours to verify. Judgment fields are I (inference) unless the evidence field says V/S.

areas.name: Player projectiles: flight, speed, collision, pierce, range (Charged Bolt, Frost Bolt, Fire Bolt)
areas.impact_why: kills/h and XP/h: time to kill a pack scales with how many bolts connect; the bot's whole damage is missiles
areas.confidence_why: game.exe missile code is 122 untouched of 130 in UNIT/Missile.cpp and 45 of 58 in MissMode.cpp; d2d's own table is mostly ported, not verified; no measured hit-rate or kill-time comparison
areas.evidence: no measurement of kills per cast or time to kill a Fallen pack on either side (U); d2d-fidelity.md section 10 item 1 lists monster HP and damage unmeasured
areas.first_step: pick Charged Bolt: read the missile create/step path of game.exe (FUN_ names from the Skills.txt srvmissile row) with disasm.py; run N casts at 20 Fallen in the unicorn oracle or compare shots-to-kill per monster type d2d vs the live bot's cast counter (telemetry has casts and kills)

areas.name: Monster counts, packs, density per area; unique and champion spawn rate; areas rebuilt per game
areas.impact_why: kills/h and XP/h are proportional to monsters met per minute walked
areas.confidence_why: DRLG outdoor generation 102 ported / 0 verified; unit placement picks differ (first match, not rarity pick, 8-cell rooms); d2d builds each level once per process; items per kill agree with live, but monsters per area were never compared
areas.evidence: d2d: 95 monsters in Blood Moor, 237 in Cold Plains on one seed (V-d2d, d2d-probes.md section 8); live per-area monster counts: not measured (U)
areas.first_step: count monsters per area (Blood Moor, Cold Plains, Stony Field, Dark Wood, Den) on d2d over 20 seeds (dump monsters, already scripted in fid_sweep.py) and on the original through the bot's memory reader on 5 fresh games; compare mean and spread per area

areas.name: XP per kill: monster exp x level, level-difference penalty, party share
areas.impact_why: XP/h is the gated metric; XP/kill by area drives which area wins
areas.confidence_why: penalty table matches (V-d2d vs S doc) but Den +60 % and Blood Moor +20 % over live at clvl 4-6 are unexplained (live logs lack monster names with XP); the XP award function was not located in the upstream data (U)
areas.evidence: d2d-fidelity.md checks 4a-4c: Cold Plains matches, Blood Moor +20 %, Den +60 % (V-d2d vs V-live); no listed upstream gap names the XP award
areas.first_step: log monster name with every XP gain in the live bot (one 1-hour Den run), compare per-monster XP with d2d's table; in parallel find the kill-reward caller in game.exe via the functions.tsv callers of the exp stat setter and diff the formula

areas.name: Spell damage: Skills.txt calc, synergies, mastery, level scaling, mana cost, to-hit of skills
areas.impact_why: kills/h: damage per bolt sets time to kill; mana cost sets potion and rest time
areas.confidence_why: skills.hpp 153 ported / 19 verified; listed gaps: skill to-hit and damage % (FUN_0056c600) not applied, fire mastery not summed, toht not added; most are off the Charged-Bolt path
areas.evidence: no damage number measured on either side for a Sorceress bolt (U); cast period measured separately (area cast_timing)
areas.first_step: for Charged Bolt, Frost Bolt, Fire Bolt at skill levels 1, 5, 10, 20: read the damage calc in game.exe (srvdofunc path) and compare d2d's min/max per level and mana cost; 12 data points, one afternoon with disasm.py

areas.name: Monster notice radius, leash, wake-on-hit, pack rally, simulation range
areas.impact_why: kills/h: how many monsters come to the player; deaths: how many wake at once
areas.confidence_why: target search FUN_005dd0b0 / 005ddc30 are verified and d2d uses the same aidist data; but d2d simulates monsters 30 cells out (more than game.exe's active rooms), a hit does not wake a sleeper, and no radius was measured on the original
areas.evidence: wake only inside 7-8 cells, 0 of 771 beyond 9 cells (V-d2d, d2d-fidelity.md check 2); original radius: not measured (U); docs/d2d-gaps.md (c) calls it data, not a bug (S)
areas.first_step: live probe on the original (cheap, already designed as plan-v2 live item): stand still 100 s in a Fallen camp, log the distance at which each first moves, 3 camps; compare with the 7-cell histogram. Static: confirm the active-room rule (which rooms tick) in game.exe via the callers of FUN_005dc380
areas.covered_by: orig-decision-probes card is for decisions, not this; no card yet

areas.name: Monster ranged attacks and spells (Fallen shamans, Dark Archers, bolts, mana burn) and missile effects on the player
areas.impact_why: deaths and potion time (the gate on deaths is loose: 1 per 1000 kills); kills/h through dodging and chasing
areas.confidence_why: monster missiles, poison, mana burn reach only a subset (listed gap); every monster missile goes through the unverified missile area; shaman and archer thinks are ported with simplifications
areas.evidence: Soaky died to a lightning-enchanted monster on the original (live log); nothing equivalent measured on d2d (U)
areas.first_step: replay the Soaky death scene as a d2d scenario: warp a clvl-12 Sorceress next to a lightning-enchanted Fallen pack with `debug` spawn verbs if any (else a seed with an enchanted unique), 30 runs: damage taken per second vs the original's log lines

areas.name: Uniques, champions, minions, enchants (fast, lightning, cursed), immunities, Act bosses
areas.impact_why: deaths (rare but decisive) and kills/h (a unique pack costs minutes)
areas.confidence_why: uniques.hpp 29 ported / 8 verified; listed gaps: at-most-two-immunities rule, fast/teleport picks, damage halving test untraced; todo: unique mods (thief, act boss deaths) untraced
areas.evidence: d2d: 1 unique and 1 superunique among 237 monsters of one Cold Plains seed (V-d2d); rates vs original: not measured (U)
areas.first_step: read the unique/champion pick (FUN_005a4f50 and callers, already verified for the modifier roll) and compare the spawn probability per pack with d2d's; then 3 modifiers that killed us (lightning enchanted, fast, extra strong) in the oracle

areas.name: Monster melee: attack rate, damage roll, to-hit vs defense, hit chance clamps
areas.impact_why: deaths and potion use; a monster that hits 20 % more often moves little of kills/h
areas.confidence_why: monster blow is rolled 'as a swing' (listed gap) and monster to-hit is the swing's plus ToHit (listed gap); attack frames from the same unverified table family as the cast frames
areas.evidence: d2d-fidelity.md section 10 item 1: monster damage and attack rate never measured on either side (U)
areas.first_step: one Fallen vs a naked Sorceress on d2d: record hits per 100 s and damage per hit; on the original read the same from the bot's life-delta log (Normal Act 1 data exists from deaths and chickens); then oracle the hit roll

areas.name: Player hit recovery, block, stun: how a hit interrupts a cast
areas.impact_why: kills/h: every interrupted cast is lost time while a pack is on the Sorceress
areas.confidence_why: listed gap: a hit taken in GH waits 2 frames in game.exe and fires at once in d2d; hit recovery length is class animation data not compared
areas.evidence: cast branch of 00623f50 is traced (casttrace); the hit-recovery branch of the same function is not (U)
areas.first_step: extend the CASTTRACE oracle (tools/emu/cast_rates.py) to the get-hit branch of 00623f50 for the Sorceress at 0 and 9 FHR; compare to d2d's GH ticks
areas.covered_by: same function as PR 128 (cast), not the GH branch

areas.name: Walk and run speed, pathing, town trip length, town portal spot, waypoint rules
areas.impact_why: kills/h: time on the road is time not killing; town trips per hour
areas.confidence_why: path code 63 of 91 untouched, 11 verified; monster path test 'always finds a path'; town portal opens 0.6 cells south, not the nearest free spot; waypoint refusal rules read from source, untested live
areas.evidence: stamina and run drain not compared with live; the bot's walk times are logged live (U for the comparison)
areas.first_step: time the same 100-cell town-to-Cold-Plains route on d2d (lockstep ticks) and from live nav logs; one number each, then the portal round trip

areas.name: Level layout: DRLG outdoor and maze, room geometry, exits, preset positions (Den mouth, camps)
areas.impact_why: kills/h through walking distance and nav stalls; bot nav depends on exits and obstacles
areas.confidence_why: outdoor.hpp 102 ported / 0 verified, but the maintainer compares generated maps with the game (S, not re-checked); DS1 layer order and DT1 shift are listed unverified
areas.evidence: Den ping-pong came from a trigger area at the warp, found on d2d only (d2d-loop r13-r17, V)
areas.first_step: compare exit-to-exit distance and obstacle count for Blood Moor and Cold Plains over 10 seeds on d2d vs the original's map reader (the bot already stores collision grids)

areas.name: Player cast frames and FCR breakpoints; attack frames and IAS
areas.impact_why: kills/h: cast period is the damage rate
areas.confidence_why: cast branch traced and run in the unicorn oracle (casttrace, V); PR 128 open; melee base frames U; Lightning SQ gap listed
areas.evidence: docs/research/cast-trace-gameexe.md (V in game.exe and oracle); fidelity check 7a: d2d 14 ticks vs table 13 (+8 %)
areas.first_step: none for casts once PR 128 merges; add the other Sorceress spells (Charged Bolt, Frost Bolt, Fire Bolt rows) to the oracle run to be sure of the 13

areas.name: Monster HP, defense, resists, damage by difficulty and area level (MonStats, MonLvl scaling)
areas.impact_why: kills/h: time to kill; deaths
areas.confidence_why: monsters.hpp 230 verified / 100 ported (the best-covered area upstream); data read from our own MPQ; resist penalty matches (V-d2d); HP spread formula and nightmare scaling lightly checked
areas.evidence: resist penalty 0/-40/-100 matches on 4 resists (V-d2d vs S); HP and damage per monster not measured (U)
areas.first_step: read the monster HP init in game.exe and run it in the oracle for 20 Normal Act 1 monsters at their area level; diff against d2d's `monsters` dump hp field

areas.name: Quest gating and rewards: Den, Blood Raven (free Rogue), Andariel, Cain; join/rebuild rules
areas.impact_why: XP/h through which area the plan farms; Den reward and BR kill order change the route
areas.confidence_why: quests.hpp 158 ported / 16 verified; quest bit words and rewards observed on d2d (V-d2d); Cain, Radament, staff pieces not reached; original behaviour unprobed (card orig-decision-probes deferred)
areas.evidence: d2d-probes.md sections 1, 2, 10: Den, BR, Andariel A-class (reward after reload), free Rogue grant on menu open (V-d2d only)
areas.first_step: the orig-decision-probes list: free Rogue grant, Andariel portal, Mephisto reload; each is one live session on Game.exe

areas.name: Mercenary: hire list, price, level, revive cost, AI, gear
areas.impact_why: kills/h (merc kills) and deaths (merc tanks); merc-policy spec numbers
areas.confidence_why: merc.hpp 19 verified / 3 ported, pets.hpp 46 verified; revive cost formula read in source, not seen live; merc gear verb absent; MonEquip hardcoded to BR's bow (todo)
areas.evidence: d2d-probes.md section 4 (hire window rows, revive cost from source; V-d2d/D2D-src)

areas.name: Life and mana regen, potions, stamina, level-up gains, vitality to life
areas.impact_why: deaths and rest time; potion heal rate sets how long a fight can be sustained
areas.confidence_why: mana regen exact, no life regen, stamina, minor healing all match (V-d2d vs S); potion double-fill missing (2 % at clvl 12); level-up gain handler not traced (listed)
areas.evidence: d2d-fidelity.md checks 1a-1e
areas.first_step: compare life and mana per level-up for a Sorceress (clvl 1..15) with game.exe's CharStats rows plus the handler; one table, 1 h

areas.name: Item requirements, two-hand and quiver pairing, belt size, equip refusal
areas.impact_why: not a gated rate; wrong rules make the bot's gear logic pass on d2d and fail on the original
areas.confidence_why: listed gaps: requirements not checked in the world's equip, slot takes it without the requirement check, belt swap does not check rows
areas.evidence: our own equip tests on d2d (d2d-loop r11: equips confirmed) never tried a refused equip (U)
areas.first_step: try equipping an item above the character's strength and level on d2d and read the result; read FUN_00562a30 for the rule

areas.name: Vendor prices, sell ratio, repair, identify, gamble, stock
areas.impact_why: gold is not a gated metric; affects poverty and trip frequency only
areas.confidence_why: tome and quiver price traced in game.exe (PR 127, FUN_0062efb0 ported not verified); sell ratio 50 % vs lore 25 % U; repair formula U
areas.evidence: d2d-gaps.md (a); docs/research/upstream-prs.md (PR 127)
areas.first_step: after PR 127: one live sale and one repair to read the sell ratio and repair formula; static read of the sell-price branch of 0062efb0

areas.name: Treasure classes, magic find, quality, gold amounts, potion and scroll drops
areas.impact_why: feeds potions and gear over hours; XP/h and kills/h are independent of it in a 2-hour run
areas.confidence_why: drops.hpp 14 verified / 6 ported; items per kill agree with live (0.39 vs 0.40, weak); gold per pile has no formula source; rare rate 3x the doc
areas.evidence: d2d-fidelity.md checks 3a-3d
areas.first_step: read the gold amount roll in game.exe; log quality of 2000 live kills at 0 MF
